Name: Rokunai's Common Food Ingredients Item Pack
Author: rokunai
Description:
20 cooking recipes that use my [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15116]Common Food Ingredients[/url] mod items!
Gus selling most of the recipes.

This mod adds the items listed below:

[list]
[*]Chocolate Banana Parfait *the name is shortened in the game because of display limitation
[*]Chocolate Bear Shaved Ice *the name is shortened in the game because of display limitation
[*]Flan
[*]Fruit Green Tea Boba [b]*the ingredient "Any Fruits" shows up as "???" and it can't be fixed by this mod[/b]
[*]Iced Coffee (default)
[*]Iced Green Tea (default)
[*]Iced Milk (default)
[*]Matcha Milk
[*]Matcha Milk Shaved Ice
[*]MAXIMUM COFFEE
[*]Polar Bear Shaved Ice
[*]Pudding a la Mode [b]*the ingredient "Any Fruits" shows up as "???" and it can't be fixed by this mod[/b]
[*]Ramune
[*]Ramune Shaved Ice
[*]Rose Milk Tea Boba
[*]Salty Caramel Parfait
[*]Soup Curry
[*]Sponge Strawberry Cake
[*]Tanuki Cake
[*]Yuenyeung (default)
[/list]
All items in this mod are compatible with the same name entities in other mods.
The mod is accepting i18n translation files without the author's permission.

[line]

[b]Is the latest version of the required (not optional) mods installed?[/b]
This mod is a content pack.
The function of the mod is completely dependent on the frameworks, which you can see in the requirements section.
Not installing the required mods or forgetting to update them may cause errors.

[b]Is the [url=https://smapi.io/log]SMAPI log [/url]parser pointing out the error caused by this mod? 
[/b]The SMAPI log parser gives you information about the error that happened in your modded game.
It tells you what mod and why it is causing the error, and you may find the problem in your condition sometimes.
If you find the error is caused by the mod (it means it's my mistake), please send me the link to your error log.
It's helpful for mod authors to fix their problems.
